note: Sounds are NOT committed: the Pixabay Content License allows free use in your videos but forbids redistributing the files on their own. engine/fetch_sfx.py downloads each sound that has a url, and tells you where to drop the rest. Every file must start on the sound (trim leading silence); a late file makes every hit late.

sounds.name: typing
sounds.use: on-screen text typing out in a chat window

sounds.name: message-send
sounds.use: a chat message or chip sent

sounds.name: message-receive
sounds.use: a chat reply or notification arriving

sounds.name: camera-shutter
sounds.use: a photo appearing

sounds.name: page-flip
sounds.use: a paper, report or PDF sliding in

sounds.name: cash-register
sounds.use: a big money number counting up

sounds.name: coin
sounds.use: the word profit or a small money chip

sounds.name: clock-tick
sounds.use: the word time or a time chip

sounds.name: alarm-clock
sounds.use: a note with an early time like 5 a.m.

sounds.name: scanner-beep
sounds.use: a QR code or barcode on screen

sounds.name: dial-up
sounds.use: an old internet brand logo (1990s, 2000s)

sounds.name: power-down
sounds.use: something being shut down or switched off

sounds.name: swipe
sounds.use: a carousel of cards turning or spinning past (one soft swipe per move, never a whoosh on a plain cut)

sounds.name: whistle
sounds.use: a referee or sports reference that is literally on screen (never for a figure of speech)

sounds.name: tap
sounds.use: a finger tap on a phone button, row or toggle on screen

sounds.name: mouse-click
sounds.use: a big on-screen cursor clicking a button (oversized-cursor)

sounds.name: rubber-stamp
sounds.use: a rubber stamp landing on a document (stamp)

sounds.name: paper-tear
sounds.use: a calendar page torn off (calendar-flip)

sounds.name: split-flap
sounds.use: a split-flap clock or board flipping (flip-clock)

sounds.name: ticket-tear
sounds.use: a numbered ticket pulled from a dispenser (ticket-dispenser)

sounds.name: pen-scribble
sounds.use: a pen writing on paper (signup-sheet, script-write)

sounds.name: receipt-printer
sounds.use: a receipt printing (receipt-print)

sounds.name: keycaps
sounds.use: keyboard keys falling and piling up (keycap-rain)

sounds.name: marker-circle
sounds.use: a marker circling or crossing something on paper (contact-sheet)

sounds.name: crack
sounds.use: an app icon cracking in two (icon-split)

sounds.name: film-projector
sounds.use: old film running, only for a film or movie reference (film-strip)
